nodes.description: Owner address state variable in Owned; initialized from msg.sender at deployment and used by the onlyOwner guard.
Pending owner address in Owned used for the two-step ownership transfer.
Constructor of Owned; sets owner = msg.sender.
onlyOwner function that stages a new owner in the newOwner state variable.
Completes the two-step ownership transfer and requires msg.sender == newOwner.
Overflow-checked addition helper (require c >= a).
Underflow-checked subtraction helper (require b <= a).
Overflow-checked multiplication helper.
Division helper that requires a non-zero divisor.
Token symbol state variable, set to XTH in the constructor.
Token name state variable, set to Xenith in the constructor.
Token decimals state variable, set to 15 in the constructor.
Total token supply state variable, set in the constructor and read by totalSupply().
Mapping from address to token balance, mutated by transfer, transferFrom and the constructor.
Nested allowance mapping (owner => spender => amount) mutated by approve and approveAndCall.
Constructor of Xenith; initializes symbol, name, decimals, _totalSupply and the initial holder balance.
Returns _totalSupply minus balances[address(0)].
Returns the token balance of tokenOwner from the balances mapping.
Transfers tokens from msg.sender to a recipient using safeSub/safeAdd.
Sets the allowance of spender for msg.sender in the allowed mapping.
Moves tokens using the allowance granted by from to msg.sender, using safe math.
Returns the remaining allowance of spender for tokenOwner.
Sets an allowance then performs an external call to receiveApproval on the spender contract.
Payable fallback function that unconditionally reverts all plain ether transfers.
onlyOwner rescue function that calls transfer on an arbitrary token contract for owner.
Caller-controlled address used for ownership, balance debits and allowance ownership.
External call in approveAndCall to ApproveAndCallFallBack(spender).receiveApproval with attacker-chosen spender and data.
External call in transferAnyERC20Token to an arbitrary tokenAddress contract via ERC20Interface.transfer.
Parameter 'to' (recipient) of transfer.
Parameter 'tokens' (amount) of transfer.
Parameter 'spender' of approve.
Parameter 'tokens' (allowance amount) of approve.
Parameter 'from' (allowance owner) of transferFrom.
Parameter 'to' (recipient) of transferFrom.
Parameter 'tokens' (amount) of transferFrom.
Parameter 'spender' of approveAndCall, also the target address of the external call.
Parameter 'tokens' (allowance amount) of approveAndCall.
Parameter 'data' of approveAndCall, forwarded as arbitrary bytes to the external call.
Parameter 'tokenAddress' of transferAnyERC20Token, target of the external call.
Parameter 'tokens' (amount) of transferAnyERC20Token.
Parameter '_newOwner' of transferOwnership written into the newOwner state variable.

edges.reason: msg.sender is written into the owner state variable in the Owned constructor, so the caller determines initial privilege.
Owned constructor executes with msg.sender as the deployer and uses it to assign ownership.
transferOwnership is guarded by the onlyOwner modifier which compares msg.sender with owner.
The _newOwner parameter is written into the newOwner state variable, staging a privilege transfer.
transferOwnership consumes its _newOwner address parameter.
acceptOwnership requires msg.sender == newOwner before transferring ownership.
newOwner is promoted into the owner state variable inside acceptOwnership.
Xenith constructor writes the symbol state variable.
Xenith constructor writes the name state variable.
Xenith constructor writes the decimals state variable.
Xenith constructor sets _totalSupply.
Xenith constructor assigns the entire supply to the initial holder in the balances mapping.
_totalSupply is transferred into balances for the deployer-specified holder address.
totalSupply reads _totalSupply and subtracts balances[address(0)].
totalSupply reads the balances mapping for address(0).
balanceOf returns the value stored in the balances mapping for tokenOwner.
transfer uses safeSub to debit the sender balance, mapping to arithmetic protection.
transfer uses safeAdd to credit the recipient balance, mapping to arithmetic protection.
transfer debits balances[msg.sender], so the caller's identity controls the source funds.
The tokens parameter flows into the safeSub/safeAdd arithmetic in transfer.
The 'to' parameter determines the credited balance in transfer.
transfer reads and writes the balances state mapping.
approve writes the tokens amount into allowed[msg.sender][spender].
approve records the allowance under allowed[msg.sender], keyed by the caller identity.
The spender parameter is the second key written in the allowed mapping.
The tokens parameter is the allowance value written in approve.
transferFrom uses safeSub for both the balance and the allowance debit.
transferFrom uses safeAdd to credit the recipient balance.
The 'from' parameter indexes both the balances and allowed mappings in transferFrom.
transferFrom spends from allowed[from][msg.sender], so the caller must hold an allowance.
transferFrom reads and decrements the allowed state mapping.
The 'to' parameter determines the credited balance in transferFrom.
The tokens parameter flows into the safeSub/safeAdd arithmetic in transferFrom.
allowance returns the value stored in the allowed mapping.
approveAndCall writes the allowance into allowed[msg.sender][spender] before the external call.
approveAndCall invokes an external contract through receiveApproval, giving control to untrusted code.
The caller-supplied spender address is cast to and called as ApproveAndCallFallBack.
msg.sender is passed as the 'from' argument of the external receiveApproval call.
Arbitrary caller-supplied bytes data is forwarded into the external call.
The tokens amount is forwarded to the external receiveApproval call.
The tokenAddress parameter is used to build the ERC20Interface used in transferAnyERC20Token.
The tokens parameter is the amount forwarded in transferAnyERC20Token.
transferAnyERC20Token performs an external call into an arbitrary token contract controlled by the argument.
transferAnyERC20Token is gated by onlyOwner and sends the rescued tokens to the owner address.
The fallback function is entered by the caller (msg.sender) on plain value transfers and always reverts.

normalization_plan.reason: The 'to' recipient parameter only has meaning inside transfer and should collapse into that function node.
The amount parameter is a temporary input of transfer and should be merged into the transfer node.
The spender parameter is only used to index the allowed mapping inside approve.
The allowance amount parameter is a transient input local to approve.
The 'from' parameter is consumed only within transferFrom for allowance-based transfers.
The 'to' recipient parameter is a transient input of transferFrom.
The amount parameter feeds the safe math calls inside transferFrom and can be merged into it.
The spender parameter directly becomes the target address of the external receiveApproval call.
The tokens parameter is a transient allowance input of approveAndCall.
The arbitrary bytes data parameter is forwarded directly into the external call.
The tokenAddress parameter is cast into the external ERC20Interface call target.
The tokens parameter is a transient amount input of the rescue function.
The _newOwner parameter is only written into newOwner by transferOwnership and should collapse into it.
